## Orchid Island Capital To Announce Third Quarter 2026 Results


October 6, 2026


[PDF Version](https://www.orchidislandcapital.com/node/13361/pdf)


VERO BEACH, Fla., Oct. 06, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Orchid Island Capital, Inc. (NYSE:ORC) ("Orchid" or the "Company"), a real estate investment trust ("REIT"), today announced that it will release results for the third quarter of 2026 following the close of trading on the New York Stock Exchange on Thursday, October 22, 2026.


**Earnings Conference Call Details**


An earnings conference call and live audio webcast will be hosted Friday, October 23, 2026, at 10:00 AM ET. Participants can register and receive dial-in information at[https://register-conf.media-server.com/register/BIfedea08824724a5a9237676385ec8a2e](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=BetBpH88Wjjkduq4IW6vArZB7gUj7tXOii3jV2F_bVd7ztDF7PALXcPb2fhDH14VcU821z5NxcIpqHAlSjvwEtQUQv0Yq8osfEgBqdjRlGzbxTi9a-d-BuDeCpDgPJtz_0BVGkFP-UUj-PJtdx1Guvog0z7t1EqNxNqYYwUixHwgLZRzUIPCULD7RAf6weRbWkOh3-UT77UJdirbKOmr_7g7g5fXu79Ro9CGG5N70jhp3ufgoSUbl1JFaNB3tiIH) **.**


A live audio webcast of the conference call can be accessed at[https://edge.media-server.com/mmc/p/hzi7tu5t](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=BetBpH88Wjjkduq4IW6vAq2uZDqyUXjdQpa4udrQiOFyddeHd8m2PrNJTkveYFhfXI69UZ11TJ_FMcCGz4L0ySN1WJjMpmGixwLtqyhHyahYRkwZwkwpa1vbmNRFer5pVUWGPuTGUdUdZeVCmnF-_DBFaa1J_46Il-SwoyTacXg=) or via the investor relations section of the Company's website at[https://ir.orchidislandcapital.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=BetBpH88Wjjkduq4IW6vAieCYDeLIljf7usQ8syKUGFlHTg2LlHDVGngjafQIjufQd9pJaSQl8O-5GshK1shX7gfc_aJGVm1eq0Z7MvaHjZnDRguJQ9yPD4WDnelAEea) . An audio archive of the webcast will be available for 30 days after the call.


**About Orchid Island Capital, Inc.**


Orchid Island Capital, Inc. is a specialty finance company that invests on a leveraged basis in Agency RMBS. Our investment strategy focuses on, and our portfolio consists of, two categories of Agency RMBS: (i) traditional pass-through Agency RMBS, such as mortgage pass-through certificates issued by Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac or Ginnie Mae and CMOs, and (ii) structured Agency RMBS. Orchid is managed by Bimini Advisors, LLC, a registered investment adviser with the Securities and Exchange Commission.
